item.text: The running LibreOffice instance is now listening on its local UNO socket. I’m going to use the Writer view cursor, jump to page 2, and insert a page break there; that should push existing page 2 content to page 3.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import uno, time
from com.sun.star.beans import PropertyValue

local_ctx = uno.getComponentContext()
resolver = local_ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', local_ctx)
ctx = resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext')
smgr = ctx.ServiceManager
desktop = smgr.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx)
doc = desktop.getCurrentComponent()
print('doc', doc.URL, doc.ImplementationName)
ctrl = doc.getCurrentController()
vc = ctrl.getViewCursor()
print('before page', vc.getPage())
print('has jumpToPage', hasattr(vc, 'jumpToPage'), 'has jumpToStartOfPage', hasattr(vc, 'jumpToStartOfPage'))
vc.jumpToPage(2)
vc.jumpToStartOfPage()
print('at page', vc.getPage())
frame = ctrl.getFrame()
dispatcher = smgr.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.DispatchHelper', ctx)
# Try InsertPagebreak command
res = dispatcher.executeDispatch(frame, '.uno:InsertPagebreak', '', 0, tuple())
time.sleep(0.5)
print('after page', vc.getPage())
# save the document
doc.store()
print('saved')
PY"
